STEM • Innovation • Teamwork • Creativity

Help us build the future through robotics.

SME Lancers Robotics 20181 (formerly 26855 Cavalry) is a school-run, student-driven program that designs, builds, and competes with high-power robots while bonding as a group and sharing our love of STEM with younger students in our community.

5 Student members
3 Competition seasons
800+ Hours of building, coding, and testing

About the team

Driven by curiosity, built by collaboration.

Engineering and Programming

Our team members design and code robots from the first idea to the final competition, learning CAD, fabrication, programming, and engineering along the way.

Developing Important Skills

Team members develop communication, project management, and team leadership skills that prepare them for future STEM careers.

Involved in Our Community

We share our work with local schools, such as Westwood View and Indian Hills, to inspire younger students to pursue robotics and engineering.
